features.name: Agent development harness
features.description: Keep project instructions, feature state, handoff notes, and repeatable verification current.

features.name: Directory data and conversion maintenance
features.description: Refresh or convert only the public dataset targeted by the active request; preserve raw source values and update derived summaries/tests when needed.
features.evidence: No active dataset refresh is requested.

features.name: Directory frontend maintenance
features.description: Improve scoped React UI behavior, language consistency, accessibility, and presentation without changing unsupported factual claims.
features.evidence: No active frontend task is recorded.

features.name: Freshness, privacy-default, and small-sample safeguards
features.description: Expose metadata-based data freshness, disclose local/external data handling, and mask 1–4 record sensitive summaries where the safeguard is enabled.
features.evidence: 2026-08-11: generated a 78-directory data-trust manifest, added the dashboard trust panel, and protected small voice-reservation counts in the children age 3+ influenza module. npm test (90 tests) and npm run build passed.

features.name: Release quality guardrails
features.description: Prevent deployments with TypeScript errors, preserve build-time data evidence, and maintain lightweight accessibility and loading contracts.
features.evidence: 2026-08-11: TypeScript is clean and enforced in the Pages workflow; deployments upload generated data-release evidence. 93 tests and production build pass.

features.name: Searchable dataset catalogue navigation
features.description: Replace the overflowing horizontal dataset strip with categorized browse and search controls that preserve existing directory views.
features.evidence: 2026-08-11: all dashboard datasets have an enforced topic category, desktop uses a searchable overlay catalogue, and mobile uses a full-screen searchable catalogue. 96 tests, typecheck, build, and manual desktop/mobile QA passed.

features.name: Bilingual repository guide
features.description: Maintain concise English and Traditional Chinese entry-point documentation with clear language switching and current operational guidance.
features.evidence: 2026-08-11: README.md and README.zh-TW.md now mirror essential onboarding, data, verification, deployment, and public-data limits.

features.name: Private cultural heritage subsidies directory
features.description: Present Taipei's private cultural-heritage subsidy records with source-preserving filtering, transparent derived analysis, and clear administrative-record limits.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: fetched and converted 292 official source rows; added the categorized dashboard module, conservative parsing tests, source-preserving CSV export, and data-quality disclosure. Typecheck, 99 tests, build, diff check, and browser QA passed.

features.name: Travel medicine clinics directory
features.description: Present official travel-medicine outpatient hospital contact records without implying real-time clinical or vaccination availability.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: fetched and converted 33 official source rows, with only O and blank mpox source values observed. Added conservative classification, local directory filters, contact and map actions, source export, and data-quality disclosure.

features.name: Taipei Hakka organizations registry
features.description: Present the 2020 Hakka organizations registry as historical source records without current-status or personal-profile inferences.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: fetched and converted the Big5-encoded official registry, preserving all seven actual CSV fields and adding source-preserving directory/search, historical-data context, and duplicate-quality checks.

features.name: Hospital discharge-to-long-term-care partner directory
features.description: Present public partner-hospital contacts for discharge-to-LTC coordination without making capacity, eligibility, or service-availability claims.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: fetched and converted 26 official source rows. Verified that the location field contains addresses, not coordinates; implemented address-only external map lookup, practical contact filters, source-preserving export, and data-quality disclosure.

features.name: Taipei fixed-site temporary childcare directory
features.description: Present official fixed-site temporary-childcare location records without inferring real-time booking, vacancies, age limits, hours, fees, eligibility, safety, or quality.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: fetched and converted 23 official source rows, preserving all five fields. Added source-preserving location and contact search, export, external map lookup only, confirmation-first messaging, and child/family privacy safeguards.

features.name: Taipei funeral service businesses registry
features.description: Present the official administrative registry without inferring current operation, services, prices, quality, eligibility, or recommendations.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: fetched and converted 30 official source rows, preserving all five fields. Added source-preserving search, filtering, export, external map lookup only, and privacy-default handling for the responsible-person field.

features.name: Withdrawn illegal-hotel enforcement history
features.description: Present withdrawn/revoked administrative enforcement records as historical source data without current-illegality or liability claims.
features.evidence: 2026-08-13: fetched and converted 37 current official source rows, preserving all eight fields with conservative ROC-date and amount parsing. The module prominently identifies the historical withdrawn/revoked record nature and avoids geocoding or blacklist semantics.
